data.title: Tom Lee-Led BitMine Reportedly Scoops Up $48.89 Million Of Ethereum During Crypto’s ‘AI Downstream’ Story
data.description: BitMine Immersion Technologies Inc (BMNR) continues to bet big on Ethereum (ETH), with the Tom Lee-led firm reportedly purchasing 20,000 ETH on Tuesday and moving closer to its goal of owning 5% of all Ether as demand for AI stocks cools within the market.On-chain tracker Lookonchain reported in a…
